title: Chinese company linked to Alice Huang obtained banned Nvidia chips: report
summary: Alice Huang, mainly known as a former top executive at Megaspeed International, also founded Shanghai Longteng Intelligent Computing, a company based in the eastern Chinese economic hub
llm_summary: Alice Huang, a former senior executive at Megaspeed International who later founded Shanghai Longteng Intelligent Computing, is tied to a Chinese firm that has reportedly acquired Nvidia chips that are prohibited for export. The chips, which are subject to U.S. sanctions, were allegedly obtained through indirect channels, raising concerns about technology leakage and compliance
